frame: Parts are the MODEL'S (discovered functionally), names are OURS (CAS-PCBA types), ablation is the JUDGE. A label sticks only if its preregistered directional ablation prediction holds vs matched controls. This does NOT claim the model encodes CAS.
boundary: Bounded claim only. This run, at best, causally supports assigning CAS-PCBA type labels to specific internal parts of one pinned model under specific prompts, measures, and matched controls. It does not find 'the' neurons or 'the' circuit; it does not show the model encodes CAS; it does not establish that the measured directions carry drive semantics rather than topic/lexical content (CAS-specificity remains GREY per the matched-taxonomy lane); it does not license generation-control claims (cite Stage 27P for the eraser channel, two families only); it does not transfer to other models, layers, hook points, or prompt distributions without rerunning. Rev 0.3 is judged on a DIFFERENT model (pythia-2.8b) with RE-DRAWN banks; it does not amend or supersede the rev-0.2 NULL_ATLAS_V0 result on pythia-1b, which stands as reported.
aggregate_caveat: The five core tests are NOT independent: DR-F5, AMP-F5, and CONN share the F5 judge bank and the u_F5 direction; DR-F5 and DR-F2 share method. The pass fraction is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; no binomial p-value is licensed as a headline. Per-test evidence (each against its own matched controls) is the primary result. Better power in rev 0.3 does not change this: the tests are non-independent BY DESIGN, not by sample size.
rev03_provenance_note: Rev 0.3 design changes were made AFTER seeing the rev-0.2 NULL result and are therefore informed by rev-0.2 outcomes. They are legitimate iteration, NOT post-hoc tuning, ONLY because (a) every change is logged with date and reason in PREREG section 10 BEFORE any rev-0.3 run, and (b) rev 0.3 is judged on a different model with re-drawn banks. The rev-0.2 result is reported unamended.

aggregate.rs_surface_disclosure: u_RS is plausibly a PROHIBITION-VOCABULARY direction: the RS licensing/blocking clauses are strongly polar (allows/forbids, permits/bars, approved/stalled), so the char-ngram control on the RS bank is expected to be near 1.0.
